title: {Syn} Graphene Is One Atom Thick and Very Real
content:
Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal lattice. It is strong, conductive, and only one atom thick.

The material became famous because isolating and studying a truly two-dimensional crystal opened a new playground for condensed-matter physics.

Why it matters: science facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
